invariants.rationale: The context is used to construct JavaUpsertPreppedDeltaCommitActionExecutor, so it is expected to be non-null.
instantTime is likely used as a commit identifier and should be non-null and non-empty.
preppedRecords is passed for processing; it should be non-null.
If preppedRecords is not empty, it should not contain null records, especially at the head.
